policy: Consume frozen numerical package unchanged. These are implementation semantics, not new fitted coefficients.
split_assignment: new patient-ID hash ordering with package seed and fractions; source split ignored
baseline_eligibility: at least two current core channels each having at least seven prior readings in the past 28 calendar days
care_day_order: onset confirmation, consultation/severe care, resolution, category close
context_overlap: maximum active mimic drive or decayed previous context
symptom_releases: only today's releases; if several, retain latest collection day; never backfill
